answer: Ask what a clone farm cannot buy in bulk, and the answer points at Signed nursing council registration with nursing council attestation. It requires a registration the council renews after revalidation and CPD, so the ridge of scaling up is a queue of real-world chores. A farm doing the maths finds the umber first: a hundred clones need a hundred proofs, and the epoch reward divided a hundred ways is already less than the cost of one. The anchor is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
